decision_summary: Retrospective: v0.6.28 converted a named readiness blocker into an executable record while preserving the boundary between structural assurance and semantic validity.
rationale: Visionary: the slice advanced the calibration roadmap without broadening QIF into an evaluation service. Builder: one canonical entity and deterministic readiness rule kept the implementation narrow. Guardian: explicit negative fixtures were necessary to prevent false healthy declarations; the remaining weakness is that uncertainty across repeated trials and infrastructure variability is still unmodeled.
recommendation: Make v0.6.29 Trial and Infrastructure Uncertainty the next slice; retain Evaluation Suite Health as a prerequisite and keep framework learning separate.
